title: Left on the Step  (Dejada en el escalón)

segments.t: Son casi las nueve de la noche y los faroles del patio brillan suavemente mientras Hannah termina su primera jornada con Graham. De pronto, la campana de la reja suena una vez en el silencio nocturno. Escucha primero.
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
Repasemos juntos cada línea de este cierre de episodio.
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
'¿Oíste eso, Graham? ¡Alguien acaba de tocar la campana de la entrada!'
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
'¿A las nueve? Espera, abramos la verja juntos.'
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
'¿Hola? ¡Buenas noches! ¡No hay nadie de pie en la verja!'
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
'Espera. Mira abajo en el escalón de piedra.'
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
'¡Otra maleta azul oscuro! ¿Es el equipaje de la señorita Evelyn?'
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
'Revisa la cremallera... ¡sí, sus iniciales están aquí mismo!'
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
'¿Por qué salió corriendo esa persona sin llevarse su propia maleta?'
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
'Mira, hay un sobre blanco doblado pegado con cinta al asa.'
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
'Déjame leerlo: "Perdón por el error. Por favor, guarden mi bolso azul hasta el viernes."'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
'¿Hasta el viernes? ¡Sin nombre, sin firma!'
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
'¿Por qué dejar tus propios zapatos y un tren de madera con desconocidos hasta el viernes?'
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
'Bienvenida a Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Tu segundo día no va a ser aburrido.'
Escuchemos la escena completa una vez más.
Did you hear that, Graham? Someone just rang the gate bell!
At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.
Hello? Good evening! Nobody is standing at the gate!
Wait. Look down on the stone step.
Another dark blue suitcase! Is this Miss Evelyn's bag?
Check the zipper... yes, her initials are right here!
Why did the person run away without taking his own suitcase back?
Look, there is a folded white envelope taped to the handle.
Let me read it: 'Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.'
Until Friday? No name, no signature!
Why leave your own shoes and wooden train with strangers until Friday?
Welcome to the Linden Courtyard Inn, Hannah. Your second day will not be boring.
La maleta de Evelyn ha vuelto, pero el desconocido desapareció en la noche pidiendo que le guarden la suya hasta el viernes. ¡Así termina el episodio uno; te esperamos en el episodio dos!
Have a good night!
